violation_type.title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Notify Parent in Writing within 14 Days if no longer carrying Insurance (26 TAC §746.207(b))
violation_type.short_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Notify Parent in Writing within 14 Days if no longer carrying Insurance
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection, liability insurance expired 8/24/2023, operation has not had insurance for 7 months. Parents were not notified.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection, liability insurance expired 8/24/2023, operation has not had insurance for 7 months. Parents were not notified.
The operation stopped carrying Liability Insurance. The insurance expired on 10/22/22.  Parents have not been notified of no liability insurance in the operation.
In reviewing three children's files, there was no documentation available for review that showed  parents have been notified that the operation no longer carries liability insurance.
Parents have not been notified within 14 days of the expiration of liability insurance as of 3/2024.
The director was unable to provide documentation showing parents were notified when the operation stopped carrying liability insurance.
